mentions.name: SnowSignals
mentions.description: Personal ski guide that combines weather, snow conditions, and resort information to create tailored day plans for skiers. Includes a snow metamorphosis model that forecasts what the snow surface skis like, a dataset of resort topography, and an optimizer that suggests how to best structure a day on the mountain.
mentions.problem: Skiers struggle to make the most of their day on the mountain no matter the conditions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building SnowSignals - the personal ski guide. We help skiers make the most of their day on the mountain no matter the conditions, combining weather, snow conditions, and resort information to create tailored plans.
